lines.text: I found my own ID in a stranger's wallet.
Last train home after Thanksgiving. Almost empty.
The wallet was under my seat. Old leather.
My name. My face. But older. Gray hair.
Behind it, a note in my handwriting.
Then the speaker crackled. "Next stop: Hollow Creek."
lines.say: Then the speaker crackled. Next stop... Hollow Creek.

lines.text: There is no Hollow Creek on this line.
The doors opened. An old man stood on the platform.
Gray hair. My coat. Crying. Waving at me.
The doors closed. I stayed on.
Then I checked my pocket. My wallet was gone.
